name: Asama Sakuya
source:
Role: Reportage writer and photographer
A beautiful woman of unknown age who appears to be in her mid-twenties, with a distinctly non-Japanese style of living. As [url=/c10490]Kei[/url]'s late mother's best friend, for whatever reason, she has taken it upon herself to look after Kei's well-being. She is frank and humorous, with the composure of an elder sister, but also has an "old-timer" side to her befitting (?) of her age. She likes alcoholic beverages and salty things. She dislikes [url=/c10500]Uzuki[/url].

[Taken from [url=http://akaiitotranslation.com/info/characters/sakuya.php]Zohar's site[/url].]
